---
title: "Managing Dotfiles Declaratively"
---

# Managing Dotfiles Declaratively

Managing dotfiles with Git bare repositories or symlink scripts (`stow`) leaves dead links and drift. The boring default is: **use `home.file."<path>".source` or `xdg.configFile` to link configuration files directly from the immutable `/nix/store`**.

## Mental model

Home Manager manages files in `$HOME`:
- `xdg.configFile."nvim/init.lua".source = ./nvim/init.lua;`
- Generates a symlink `~/.config/nvim/init.lua -> /nix/store/...-init.lua`.
- Files in `/nix/store` are read-only: prevents accidental in-place mutation without committing to Git.

## Worked examples

Save as `dotfiles.nix`:

```nix
# dotfiles.nix
{
  xdg.configFile."desk/settings.json".text = builtins.toJSON {
    theme = "dark";
    autoSync = true;
  };
}
```

Home Manager renders JSON, YAML, and INI configuration files purely from Nix data structures.

## The boring rule

- Use `xdg.configFile` for modern XDG-compliant configuration paths.
- Store configuration templates directly in Git alongside your Nix files.
